verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's first-party docs show a page can be scraped with one API request that needs only an API key and the encoded target URL. Several parameters describe the API returning the page's HTML, and the core product is an 'HTML API'. JavaScript rendering is on by default, so the HTML returned is the rendered page unless configured otherwise. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTML response, and documentation of a way to get the unrendered source HTML (e.g. turning JS rendering off).
